q: 图画作文万能开头（描述图画）
a: As is vividly depicted in the picture/cartoon, + 图画内容.
n: depict 可换成 portray / illustrate / present；almost 所有图画作文第一句

a: As is symbolically revealed in the drawing, ... mirrors a thought-provoking social phenomenon.
n: mirror 此处作动词"反映"

a: Recently, the issue of ... has been brought into public focus / aroused wide public concern.
n: arouse wide public concern 引起公众广泛关注

a: With the rapid development of ..., an increasing number of people ...
n: development 可换 advance / popularity

a: Nowadays, there is a growing tendency that ... / a growing tendency to do sth.
n: growing tendency 日益增长的趋势

a: When it comes to ..., opinions vary from person to person.
n: when it comes to 谈到/涉及

a: It is universally acknowledged that ...
n: 比 As we all know 更正式，写作加分

a: Nothing is more important than the fact that ... / Nothing matters more than ...
n: 否定+比较级=最高级效果

a: The chart/graph shows a steady increase in ... from ... to ...
n: steady increase 稳步上升｜sharp rise 急升

a: As can be seen from the table/chart, ...（后接主要数据或趋势）
n: 亦可用 As is shown in the chart, ...

a: ... accounted for 40% of the total, ranking first among all categories.
n: account for 占（比例）；ranking first 现在分词作结果状语

a: The number of ... increased by X%, nearly doubling/tripling over the period.
n: increase by 增加了；double/triple 翻倍/三倍

a: There was a sharp decline in ..., whereas ... witnessed a slight rise.
n: whereas 表对比；witness 拟人用法加分

a: The figures fluctuated slightly before climbing to a record high.
n: fluctuate 波动｜a record high 历史最高

a: The reasons for this phenomenon are not far to seek.
n: = 原因不难找，接下来分点论述

a: First and foremost, ... Moreover, ... Last but not least, ...
n: 比 Firstly/Secondly/Thirdly 更地道

a: ... plays an indispensable role in ...
n: indispensable 不可或缺的（高分词）

a: It is ... that ...（例：It is diligence that leads to success.）
n: It is + 被强调部分 + that + 其余；中考语法高频

a: Only in this way / Only by doing sth can we ...
n: Only + 状语提前，句子部分倒装（can we...）

a: There is no denying that ... / No one can deny that ...
n: 后接完整句子

a: ... is a double-edged sword, which brings both opportunities and challenges.
n: 适合讨论科技/网络等利弊话题

a: What we should do is to strike a balance between A and B.
n: strike a balance between 在……之间取得平衡

a: While some argue that ..., others hold the opposite view that ...
n: hold the view that 持有……观点

a: Admittedly, ... However, this does not mean that ...
n: Admittedly 诚然；比 but 高级的转折

a: Compared with A, B enjoys the advantage of ...
n: enjoy 此处="拥有（优势）"

a: On the one hand, ...; on the other hand, ...
n: 注意固定搭配：on the one hand ... on the other（hand）

a: ... is not without its drawbacks, though.
n: 双重否定=并非没有缺点（简洁高级）
h: …is not without its drawbacks, though.（双重否定=并非没有缺点）

a: Take ... for example: ...（或 Take ... as an example.）
n: 举具体名人事例最常用

a: A case in point is ...
n: case in point 恰当的例子

a: ... serves as a typical illustration of ...
n: illustration 例证（不是"插画"）

a: Evidence abounds that ...
n: abound 大量存在；后接同位语从句

a: This phenomenon can be attributed to several factors.
n: attribute A to B 把A归因于B

a: As a result / Consequently, ...
n: Consequently 比 so 正式

a: ... gives rise to / leads to / results in ...
n: give rise to 带来、引起

a: Thanks to / Owing to / Due to ..., ...
n: thanks to 多含褒义"多亏"

a: It is no surprise that ... / It comes as no surprise that ...
n: 接从句

a: In conclusion / To sum up / All in all, ...
n: 三选一，别重复用

a: From what has been discussed above, we can safely draw the conclusion that ...
n: safely 此处="稳妥地"，不是"安全"

a: It is (high) time that we put an end to ... / did sth.
n: that 从句用过去式或 should + 动词原形（虚拟语气）

q: 倒装结尾：只有共同努力
a: Only by working together / joining hands can we build a better future.
n: 倒装句收尾很有气势

a: Every coin has two sides, and ... is no exception.
n: is no exception 也不例外

a: As the saying goes, "Where there is a will, there is a way."
n: 常用谚语：有志者事竟成

a: Let us join hands and make concerted efforts to ...
n: concerted efforts 共同努力

a: I firmly believe that with joint efforts, ... will embrace a brighter future.
n: embrace 拥抱（拟人加分）

a: In a word, ... deserves our attention and action.
n: deserve 值得；in a word 总而言之
